description: This Java class 'CheckInAndDeleteDataItemsService' handles location-based notification actions such as 'Check In' and deletion of DataItems in a wearable app, utilizing GoogleApiClient and Wearable DataApi.

classes.name: CheckInAndDeleteDataItemsService
classes.description: An IntentService that handles 'Check In' actions and deletes DataItems when notifications are dismissed, integrating with GoogleApiClient and Wearable DataApi.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes GoogleApiClient with Wearable API and connection callbacks.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming intents for check-in or delete actions, performs DataItem deletion via Wearable DataApi.

methods.name: startConfirmationActivity
methods.description: Creates and starts a confirmation animation activity on the wearable device.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback for GoogleApiClient connection success (empty implementation).

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Callback for GoogleApiClient connection failure (empty implementation).
